text: Is your formulation, including its ingredients and method of preparation, described in one of the authoritative books listed in the First Schedule to the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945?
why_asked: This determines whether the product is a classical (generic) Ayurvedic medicine or a proprietary/new formulation, which changes the entire compliance path.

ev_dnc001.doc_title: The Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules, 1945
ev_dnc001.text: formulations described in the authoritative books of Ayurveda, Siddha and Unani systems listed in the First Schedule are treated as classical/generic medicines for licensing purposes (illustrative paraphrase).
